## 🚀 Feature Description

<!-- What would you like to see added or improved? -->
<!-- Be as specific as possible! -->

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like.

## 💡 Why is this needed?

<!-- Help us understand WHY this feature would be useful. -->
<!-- Example: "As a beginner, I find it hard to understand X because..." -->

Explain the problem this feature would solve.

## 🎨 Proposed Solution

<!-- Do you have an idea of HOW to implement this? -->
<!-- Don't worry if you don't — that's okay too! -->

Describe the solution you'd like.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

<!-- Have you thought of other ways to solve this? -->

List any alternative solutions you've considered.

## 📚 Examples / References

<!-- Is there a similar project or tool that does this well? -->
<!-- Share links or screenshots! -->

Add any relevant examples, screenshots, or links.

## 🎯 Who would benefit?

- [ ] Beginners learning cloud infrastructure
- [ ] Experienced engineers
- [ ] Everyone who uses this project
- [ ] Other: _____

## 📌 Additional Context

<!-- Anything else we should know? -->

Add any other context here.

> 💡 **Not sure if your idea is good enough?** Submit it anyway! All ideas are welcome. The worst that can happen is we discuss it and find an even better solution together! 🙌
